_notes: MADETRUE launch rehearsal — REAL maker details only. Copy this file to scripts/launch-makers.json (git-ignored, never commit it) and fill every field from the maker's own words. Rules and field-by-field guidance: docs/launch-rehearsal.md (Part B).

Every product without a photo stays status 'pending' — the maker uploads a real photo via their dashboard, then an admin approves it in the console. Listings carry the exact badge strings: 'Same Day Delivery', 'Pickup Available', 'Fresh Today', 'Locally Made', 'Eco-Friendly'.
Coordinates must sit inside Ernakulam district (delivery is Ernakulam-only). The script refuses placeholder values like the ones below.
payout_kyc is optional — fill it only when the maker's PAN/bank details are already in hand; Cashfree vendor registration itself waits for Phase 6 Step 7.

makers.name: REPLACE — maker's real name, e.g. Lakshmi
makers.email: REPLACE — a real address the maker can log in with
makers.password: REPLACE — at least 8 characters, shared privately with the maker
makers.business_name: REPLACE — the store name buyers will see
makers.story: REPLACE — the maker's story in their own words, 2-4 sentences
makers.address: REPLACE — real street address inside Ernakulam, Kerala

products.name: REPLACE — listing name
products.description: REPLACE — what it is, how it is made, why it is good
products.category: REPLACE — an existing slug like spices / homemade-foods / handicrafts / fresh-produce / organic-honey
images: REPLACE — https:// URL of a REAL photo the maker sent (leave the array empty to upload later via the dashboard)
products.origin_details: REPLACE — where the ingredients / material come from
